items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Tiro Calico, was that the guy? I forgot. A little short guy. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, a little short Italian fella. Gray hair. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.

ctx.x: Some of them did it. When they come to Elmore, Elmore told them I'd be damned if I'm doing it. And she tried for her doing this to get it done. Uh-huh. But they wouldn't do it at our place. The doghouse had it for a while. And, uh, Puffy House and them had shoes there. They had a little place, Searrow. Searrow's in Fernhorn. Biamble between Bourbon and Royal, I think it was. I worked in there for him. And I also was booking bands in there for him. I supplied it one time, I was the only black band out in the…
Tiro Calico, was that the guy? I forgot. A little short guy.

Yeah, a little short Italian fella. Gray hair. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. And, uh, and everybody saw what a good band we had. And we was there on time every night. And they used to come around to me and ask, can they get a band, could I have a band like me. And I must have put about five or six different bands out there in the French quarters. Yeah. Well, Cole, Tucker Cole, he passed away in Chicago. Now he was stranded here in New Orleans some time ago. And I started him out in the French quarters. I started Laverne…
